warning: Red: KDFWR waterfowl refuges. The Ballard Zone is its own zone (blind spacing; public land closed for September geese). Federal refuges set their own rules (Refuges layer).
source: KDFWR 2026–27 Hunting Guide for Migratory Birds and Waterfowl; KDFWR restricted areas (waterfowl refuges).

areas.d: Closed to migratory game bird hunting Sept 30 – Nov 30, 2026 (the first duck days, Nov 26–29, fall inside the closure). LBL hunt permit required. Outline: the whole NRA.

Closed to migratory game bird hunting within ¾ mile of the dam, on the Deer Creek Branch, the shores of Camp Webb and the state park. Outline: the whole WMA; those parts are closed.
The Greenbrier Creek Branch of Yatesville Lake north of the mouth of the branch, islands included, is closed to migratory game bird hunting. Outline: the whole WMA; that part is closed.
